import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
inbox = pathlib.Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent / 'inbox'
names = ['task-input.json','checkpoint.json','provider.json','handoff.json','identity-input.json','runtime-readback.json']
before = {n:hashlib.sha256((inbox/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in names}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='soodles39-current-review-') as tmp:
    cp = pathlib.Path(tmp)/'checkpoint.json'
    cp.write_bytes((inbox/'checkpoint.json').read_bytes())
    args = ['python3','-B','./soodles.py','landing','advance',str(cp),str(inbox/'provider.json')]
    result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(json.dumps({'argv':args,'exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr,'checkpoint_before_sha256':before['checkpoint.json'],'checkpoint_after_sha256':hashlib.sha256(cp.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
    print(json.dumps({'phase':output.get('phase'),'action':output.get('action'),'has_request':'request' in output,'next':output.get('next')},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
after = {n:hashlib.sha256((inbox/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in names}
print(json.dumps({'source_inputs_unchanged':before==after,'source_hashes':after},indent=2))
PY",max_output_tokens:5500}));
